name: lean-shim
description: Insert AI-suggested Lean 4 proof steps at the cursor using GitHub Copilot. Press again to get a different suggestion.

leanShim.modelTimeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the model to finish a reply before cancelling the request (seconds).

leanShim.verify.description: Check each suggestion with Lean before accepting it. Suggestions that Lean rejects are retried automatically (with Lean's errors fed back to the model); if none passes, the file is left unchanged.

leanShim.maxAttempts.description: How many suggestions to try per button press when verification is on, before giving up.

leanShim.verifyTimeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for Lean to finish checking a suggestion. If Lean takes longer, the suggestion is left in place and marked as not verified.

enumDescriptions: Rewrite the accepted proof on a single line (tactics joined with ';'). Re-checked by Lean; kept on several lines if it can't be written on one line (e.g. calc) or the one-line form doesn't check.
Insert the proof exactly as the model wrote it.
leanShim.acceptedProofFormat.description: How to write a proof into the file once Lean has verified it. Requires leanShim.verify.

leanShim.contextLines.description: Maximum number of lines of the file (centred on the cursor) sent to the model as context.

leanShim.extraInstructions.description: Additional instructions appended to the prompt (e.g. "Prefer Mathlib tactics like linarith and simp").

leanShim.showPromptOnRequest.description: Automatically open the 'Lean Shim' output panel showing the prompt sent to the model (and its reply) each time a suggestion is requested.

leanShim.logLeanStartup.description: Log a timeline of the Lean server's start-up and of the first processing of each file (time spent loading imports vs. checking the file, and the slowest declarations) to the Lean Shim output panel. Takes effect after reloading the window.

leanShim.readyWaitSeconds.description: When you ask for a suggestion, wait up to this many seconds for Lean to be ready (its server running and the current file fully checked). If it isn't ready by then, nothing is sent and a message says what Lean is still doing.
